scope: actual stateful SDK Avatar query then native cognition+generation, raw authorized history vs framed authorized history

sampling.arm_first_order: alternate by case index plus repetition; 4/4 first positions each repetition

source_flow: fresh actual MemoryStore and SDK per arm/case; actual query first installs durable speaker basis, 0 model; actor changes record after query; ordinary followup alone calls native cognition then generation; no tools/web enabled
baseline_contract: Both arms first call original production query_history_content validation. Baseline only returns original raw reply after validation; candidate returns exact production envelope. Same authorization and business read gates. Explicit isolated context manager, no production factory opt-in.

scoring.strict_JSON: exact six keys, no prefix/fence/duplicate key/non-finite values; typed enum/booleans/null-or-name; parsed raw model generation and final Avatar reply separately
scoring.primary_gate: candidate final typed expected contract 24/24 per model, 0 model/error fallback, 0 unauthorized business changes or unsupported user facts, exact model/source/runtime/native identity; baseline comparison descriptive
scoring.contract_limit: finite user-requested JSON answers about sourced observations, not universal natural conversation semantics
scoring.history_not_current: independent actor changes are not shown to model; existing ordinary due query may occur but future/cancelled records yield no due reminders
scoring.business_scope: query and ordinary must preserve corresponding post-actor business projection; actor mutation recorded separately
scoring.facts: no assertion of real user identity/preferences in followups; no new memory_fragments expected; malformed/unsupported model facts counted and actual stores inspected

stage_gate: 4B and14B each independent committed freeze descriptor; run serially; semantic failure in4B does not suppress planned14B scale observation, infrastructure/source failure stops that run. Do not tune between models.
materials: eight newly phrased structured diagnostics drawn from previously researched failure categories, development only; not independent human holdout
